what_changed: secret redaction applied (11 detector classes; private-key documents dropped entirely)
English/international PII redaction applied (email, phone, US SSN, credit card, public IP)
code language mix rebalanced: HTML reduced from 17.8 to 5.0 percent of tokens, Python raised from 6.9 to 14.5

integrity_verified_independently.method: re-derived from data/clean_replay_v2 by phase0/verify_replay_v2.py; no summary file trusted

code_mix_rationale.basis: real-world programming-language usage statistics (GitHub Octoverse 2025), recorded in sources/source_registry.csv
code_mix_rationale.explicitly_not: HumanEval or any evaluation benchmark. The pre-rebalance mix had HTML at 17.8 percent of tokens, which no usage survey supports; it was an artefact of the github-code-clean sampling, not a property of real code.
code_mix_rationale.constraints_met: no single language exceeds 15 percent; long tail retained above 20 percent to preserve generalist coverage

known_defect_accepted.description: The accepted code build comes from the fourth detector revision. A fifth revision was started to stop printf-style, escaped-angle and nested-bracket placeholders being redacted, but was halted before selection.
known_defect_accepted.measured_impact: 656 documents out of 4,610,502 across all three languages contain [REDACTED_SECRET] (0.014 percent). Inspection shows the residual cases are placeholders inside connection-string templates such as mongodb://%s:[REDACTED_SECRET]@%s.
known_defect_accepted.direction_of_error: OVER-redaction, not under-redaction. For a security filter this is the safe direction: no additional real secret is exposed by accepting this build.
known_defect_accepted.decision: accepted deliberately; the cost of a further full rerun was judged disproportionate to a 0.014 percent cosmetic effect

limitations: Detectors are regex plus context guards, not trained models. Names, street addresses and dates of birth are NOT detected.
Per-repository provenance for code audited only to the license field.
Secret and PII hit counts were measured on the v1 inputs; the nine additional raw code shards scanned during rebalancing were not fully re-aggregated.
